summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a consolidated summary remote voting report for an Extraordinary General Meeting originally called for May 28, 2026 and postponed to June 8, 2026. The agenda includes amendments to the bylaws to reflect a new Shareholders Agreement (Material Fact of April 23, 2026), governance improvements, and authorization for the Board of Directors to anticipate the end of the current term of the Board of Executive Officers. While the filing primarily covers governance changes, the provision to anticipate executive officer terms suggests potential for abrupt management changes. The vote results show strong support and opposition on certain items. Watch for follow-up on the actual acceleration of executive terminations.
